title: Delineating Oxidation Aspects of an Additively Manufactured Nanoprecipitation-Strengthened Al<sub>0.2</sub>Co<sub>1.5</sub>CrFeNi<sub>1.5</sub>Ti<sub>0.3</sub> High-Entropy Alloy.

recollection.intervention: Additive manufacturing followed by oxidation studies
recollection.structure: Nanoprecipitation-strengthened microstructure, likely with fine precipitates dispersed in a HEA matrix
recollection.mechanism: Oxidation resistance possibly due to the formation of protective oxide layers and the role of nanostructured precipitates in impeding oxide growth
recollection.results: Probably reports oxidation kinetics, oxide layer composition, and compares oxidation resistance to conventional alloys; quantitative results might include oxidation rates, activation energies, and microstructural analysis of oxide scales

score.note: The recollection only generically identifies additive manufacturing, nanoprecipitates, and protective oxide formation. It misses the key 750°C/50 h aging comparison, the specific L12/L21 precipitate structures, the continuous Cr2O3-based scale and diffusion mechanism, and all reported kinetic exponents and activation energies.
